sourcing.note: The Bengaluru points are named stands and localities on the corridors the research describes, and their coordinates are approximate town-level positions taken from public mapping. The Chennai points are named localities the research lists as boarding and dropping points on the Bengaluru-Chennai corridor; no coordinate was sourced for any of them and none is published. A boarding point with no coordinate publishes none rather than one synthesised from a town centroid: 2026-dated complaints against the incumbents still report a pin that does not match where the coach actually stops, so a pin is only as trustworthy as the operational data behind it.
